name: Beck Depression Inventory–II (BDI-II)
directions: Self-report, past two weeks including today. Choose the one statement in each group that best describes you; when more than one applies, select the highest number. For sleep and appetite select only one direction. Endorsement of item 9 activates the safety support pathway. Not a diagnosis or crisis assessment.

questions.definition: 0 not sad; 1 sad much of the time; 2 sad all the time; 3 so sad or unhappy I can't stand it.
0 not discouraged about future; 1 more discouraged than before; 2 don't expect things to work out; 3 future hopeless and will only get worse.
0 don't feel like a failure; 1 failed more than I should; 2 see many failures looking back; 3 total failure as a person.
0 as much pleasure as ever; 1 enjoy things less; 2 very little pleasure; 3 no pleasure from things I used to enjoy.
0 not particularly guilty; 1 guilty over many things; 2 quite guilty most of the time; 3 guilty all the time.
0 don't feel punished; 1 may be punished; 2 expect to be punished; 3 feel punished.
0 feel the same about myself; 1 lost confidence; 2 disappointed in myself; 3 dislike myself.
0 no more self-critical than usual; 1 more critical; 2 criticize myself for all faults; 3 blame myself for everything bad.
0 no thoughts of killing myself; 1 thoughts but would not carry them out; 2 would like to kill myself; 3 would kill myself if I had the chance.
0 no more than usual; 1 cry more; 2 cry over every little thing; 3 feel like crying but can't.
0 no more restless or wound up than usual; 1 more restless; 2 hard to stay still; 3 have to keep moving or doing something.
0 no loss of interest in people or activities; 1 less interested; 2 lost most interest; 3 hard to get interested in anything.
0 decide as well as ever; 1 more difficult; 2 much greater difficulty; 3 trouble making any decisions.
0 don't feel worthless; 1 less worthwhile/useful than before; 2 more worthless than others; 3 utterly worthless.
0 as much energy as ever; 1 less energy; 2 not enough energy to do very much; 3 not enough energy to do anything.
0 no change; 1a somewhat more / 1b somewhat less; 2a a lot more / 2b a lot less; 3a sleep most of day / 3b wake 1–2 hours early and cannot return to sleep.
0 not more irritable; 1 more irritable; 2 much more irritable; 3 irritable all the time.
0 no change; 1a somewhat less / 1b somewhat greater; 2a much less / 2b much greater; 3a no appetite / 3b crave food all the time.
0 concentrate as well as ever; 1 not as well; 2 hard to keep mind on anything long; 3 cannot concentrate on anything.
0 no more tired than usual; 1 tire more easily; 2 too tired for many usual activities; 3 too tired for most usual activities.
0 no recent change; 1 less interested; 2 much less interested; 3 lost interest completely.
